bio: Let yourself be courted by culinary creations in which the Mediterranean meets elegant Gallic cuisine. The house signature, Bottoni Carbonara, delicious raviolis with a melt-in-the-mouth centre, are flanked by a fragrant Parmesan mousse and crispy slivers of pork crackling. The tender veal fillet, enhanced by a velvety sauce, is truly worth writing home about. Make yourself comfortable in the glamorous, clean-edged interior, or on the terrace in summertime. A carefully chosen selection of wines by the glass completes this gourmet interlude. An address to discover forthwith!...
